definition: `Creature x`: x is one of the things ST I q.13 a.5 calls creatures, which are ordered to God as to their principle and cause. In Lean it is an uninterpreted predicate on beings; only the open premise `OthersAreCreaturesReading Creature p` links it to the primary, by saying that everything other than p falls under it.
note: Stipulated so that STMT-CREATURES-ORDERED-TO-PRIMARY-AS-CAUSE states no more than q.13 a.5 co., which speaks of creatures and not of everything other than God. Aquinas' account of creation (ST I q.44-45, e.g. q.45 a.1, creatio as emanatio totius entis) would source a fuller definition; none is needed by the current results.
